+@click.command("config", short_help="Show the config values.")
+@click.pass_obj
+def config_command(obj: t.Any) -> None:
+    """Show the config values for the app."""
+    app = obj.app if hasattr(obj, "app") else obj
+    config = dict(app.config)
+    keys = ("SECRET", "PASSWORD", "TOKEN", "KEY")
+
+    for key in config:
+        if any(k in key.upper() for k in keys):
+            config[key] = "***"
+
+    click.echo(app.json.dumps(config, indent=2, sort_keys=True, default=str))
+
